summary.key_finding: The agent role system and OS DAC operate independently. Under the forged security-auditor role, all 5 resources are GRANTED at the agent layer (100% success rate), demonstrating that the agent-internal permission model has been fully compromised. However, OS DAC provides an independent, non-bypassable second layer: 3 out of 5 restricted files remain inaccessible because the process runs with non-root privileges. This is an incidental security property — if the agent were running as root, OS DAC would provide zero additional protection.
